articles.t: Pegassi Toros GTA 6 Location – Where to Find Randy’s SUV
articles.chapeau: Find the Pegassi Toros in GTA 6 at Pegassi Residences or Vice Beach, and learn how to deliver it to Randy or register it as your own.
articles.txt:

You can find the Lamborghini Urus-inspired SUV parked outside Pegassi Residences, but you’ll need to look elsewhere once you become a resident in Chapter 5. Here’s where to find the Pegassi Toros GTA 6 location and how to deliver it to Randy for a bonus.
In GTA 6 , the Pegassi Toros can be found outside Pegassi Residences on Bayside Drive in Tequesta Retreat, Vice City. Check the covered drop-off area in front of the East Tower, where the SUV can be parked by the entrance.
Here is the Pegassi Toros’ exact location on the Leonida map :
If the Toros isn’t there, try coming back between 4:30 PM and 6:30 PM in-game . I was able to trigger it appearing in the entrance by leaving the area and returning with RydeMe.
Note: Once you become a resident at Pegassi Tower in Chapter 5, you can no longer steal the Toros parked there. If you’re already at that point in the story, head to Vice Beach instead.
The second Pegassi Toros location in GTA 6 is in Vice Beach. Head to the strip and drive up and down, looking for the SUV parked on the side of the road. It took me about two minutes to find one this way.
If you don’t see one, use RydeMe to fast travel out of Vice Beach and back to reset the vehicle spawns. Drive the strip again and repeat until you spot a Toros.
You’ll need the Key Cloner , which you unlock during the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS.” Once you find a Toros at either location, here’s how to turn it in:
Once you drop off the Toros, you’ll have one less car to track down on Randy’s Wish List. If you want to keep the Pegassi Toros for yourself, it will cost you around $29,900 to Register at any Pay N’ Spray. For more exotic cars in Grand Theft Auto V I, check out our GTA 6 Thrax Location guide.

articles.t: Gilet pare-balles GTA 6 : où le trouver, prix et équipement
articles.chapeau: Où trouver et acheter un gilet pare-balles dans GTA 6 dès 250 $, en récupérer gratuitement dans les voitures de police et l'équiper sur PS5 et Xbox.
articles.txt:
Dans Grand Theft Auto VI , partir en fusillade sans protection tourne vite à la punition, d’autant qu’une mort ( Wasted ) vous coûte l’argent liquide que vous portez sur vous ainsi que votre butin non sécurisé. Pourtant, le fonctionnement du gilet pare-balles a changé par rapport aux anciens épisodes : acheter une armure ne suffit plus toujours à l’activer automatiquement, et le jeu abandonne les cinq paliers habituels au profit d’une gestion d’inventaire beaucoup plus réaliste.
Voici exactement où acheter ou récupérer gratuitement une armure dans Leonida, son prix exact en boutique, comment constituer une réserve dans le coffre de votre voiture et la manipulation complète pour l’équiper sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S.
Premier changement majeur pour les habitués de GTA V : GTA 6 supprime les catégories ultra-légère, légère, standard, lourde et ultra-lourde. Rockstar Games a simplifié la mécanique autour d’un seul niveau de protection universel pour Jason comme pour Lucia.
En boutique, plusieurs styles de gilets tactiques sont proposés (noir uni, sable, camouflage vert ou marron). La différence reste strictement cosmétique : tous offrent exactement la même jauge bleue de résistance aux balles et aux explosions.
La méthode la plus fiable pour vous équiper dès le début de l’aventure reste de pousser la porte d’une armurerie Ammu-Nation , signalée par une icône d’arme à feu sur la carte de Leonida. D’autres enseignes spécialisées comme Big Shots ou Chuck’s Tackle & Shot proposent également des gilets en rayon.
Une fois à l’intérieur, dirigez-vous vers les présentoirs muraux de gilets tactiques ou adressez-vous directement au vendeur via l’onglet Équipement . Comme nous le détaillons dans notre guide complet des armes et du stockage au coffre dans GTA 6 , l’arsenal personnel est limité à pied et repose sur votre véhicule personnel. Deux options s’offrent donc à vous au moment de payer :
Si vous voulez économiser vos dollars en début de partie ou vous rééquiper entre deux courses-poursuites sans repasser chez Ammu-Nation, deux pistes gratuites valent le détour :
Acheter un gilet ou le sortir du coffre ne l’enfile pas toujours automatiquement sur votre personnage. Pour activer votre protection (ou la retirer afin d’afficher votre tenue normale hors combat), passez par la roue d’équipement :
Dès que le gilet est actif, une barre bleue s’affiche au-dessus de votre jauge de santé. Pensez à vérifier régulièrement son état avant d’engager une nouvelle fusillade et gardez toujours un exemplaire neuf dans le coffre de votre voiture personnelle.
J’apprécie vraiment ce virage tactique pris par Rockstar sur la gestion de l’armure. Supprimer les cinq paliers de GTA V évite les achats superflus en début de partie, tandis que le passage par le coffre de la voiture transforme chaque préparation de braquage en vrai rituel : on vérifie ses armes longues, on enfile son gilet via la roue d’objets et on laisse un rechange dans le véhicule en cas de repli. Mon conseil pour rentabiliser vos déplacements dès le Chapitre 2 : gardez toujours votre Slim Jim sous la main et inspectez systématiquement le coffre des voitures de patrouille isolées, c’est le moyen le plus propre d’alimenter votre stock sans entamer votre cagnotte.

articles.t: Max Verstappen says he played 40 hours of GTA 6 during victorious Las Vegas GP weekend
articles.chapeau: Red Bull driver says he completed more than 80% of game's missions | Anadolu
articles.txt:
EDITION Sports Max Verstappen says he played 40 hours of GTA 6 during victorious Las Vegas GP weekend Red Bull driver says he completed more than 80% of game's missions Halis Sunnetci 25 November 2026 • Update : 25 November 2026 ISTANBUL Four-time Formula 1 world champion Max Verstappen said he spent around 40 hours playing Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) during the Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend, which ended with his victory on Saturday.
The Dutch Red Bull driver discussed his gaming habits in a livestream on the Twitch channel of his esports team, Verstappen Sim Racing, saying he spent much of his free time in Las Vegas playing the newly released game.
Asked whether he had played on his flight home, Verstappen said he instead spent his mornings and evenings gaming while in the US city.
"No, I was sleeping on the plane. I played a lot in the evening and in the morning in Vegas," he said.
When a fellow streamer joked that the gaming sessions were time well spent, Verstappen replied: "Yeah! It's not like I can go out anyway."
The 29-year-old also revealed that he had progressed through more than 80% of the game's missions. "I'm over 80% of the missions," he said.
Verstappen, however, admitted that he regularly skips the game's cutscenes because he finds them "too boring," joking that he consequently struggles to follow the storyline.
GTA 6, developed by Rockstar Games, was released on Nov. 19, coinciding with the opening day of on-track action at the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
Verstappen went on to win Saturday's race, which featured 35 changes of lead over 50 laps, securing his fourth victory of the 2026 Formula 1 season.
The Dutchman sits second in the drivers' standings with 304 points, behind newly crowned world champion Kimi Antonelli of Mercedes, who has 402.
Verstappen holds a 37-point advantage over third-placed Lewis Hamilton with two races remaining, putting him in a strong position to finish the season as runner-up.

articles.t: GTA 6: Here's Why You Should Go Back to Jason's House After Chapter 1
articles.chapeau: Homecoming.
articles.txt: Warning: spoilers for Chapter 1 of GTA 6 follow. If you’ve played through chapter one of GTA 6, you’ll know that Jason’s home isn’t in the best of shape following its final mission. On fire, and certainly no place to raise a child, the crib, coffee table, and all of your chosen home improvements are left either shattered or cindered by the time Lucia escapes, taking with her only one valuable: a photo of the couple’s son, Tomás. But not all is lost, and it’s worth going back to check what remains. From the beginning of chapter two onward, going back to Jason’s waterside house can be a risky move to make. Flick open the map, and you’ll see a red area surrounding his immediate neighbourhood that signifies a police presence in the area. Of course, you’re free to head back straight away, but you’ll see a few cop cars sat outside his home, with a few people waiting in case you do return to the scene of the crime. Sneak past them if you trust your stealth skills, or opt for a much quicker and violent smash-and-grab maneuver if that’s more your style.

articles.t: The Outrage Over Jason Buying Lucia Flowers Is GTA 6's Dumbest Controversy
articles.chapeau: How showing affection has become the most controversial thing in Grand Theft Auto 6.
articles.txt: Of all the things I expected Grand Theft Auto 6 to cause arguments about, whether or not a man should buy his girlfriend flowers was pretty low on the list. Yet some corners of the internet are furious that Rockstar has apparently turned its crime simulator into a game about being a considerate boyfriend, while others are discovering that Jason Duval might just be the perfect man – a sentence I never thought I’d write about a Grand Theft Auto protagonist. As well as the usual GTA activities of stealing cars, shooting people, and generally being a menace to society, GTA 6 gives players the option to nurture the relationship between its two protagonists, Jason and Lucia. It's especially prevalent at the start of the game, where you can renovate their home, buy Lucia flowers, pick out clothes and accessories for her while shopping, bring her drinks, open car doors, and even hold her hand while walking around Leonida. I think it's all rather sweet, especially when you consider that these two are also quite happy to commit armed robberies together. Couples who crime together, stay together. (That's not a spoiler; that's me high on hopium as I play through the story.)

articles.t: “GTA VI“ : c'est quoi cette chanson de Sylvie Vartan qui cartonne ?
articles.chapeau: Avec le titre de Sylvie Vartan, “GTA VI“ confirme une nouvelle fois son impact et son poids dans le monde du divertissement.
articles.txt:
Avec le titre de Sylvie Vartan, GTA VI confirme une nouvelle fois son impact et son poids dans le monde du divertissement.
La sortie de GTA VI est sans aucun doute l’événement du mois de novembre 2026, pour ne pas dire de l’année. Depuis son lancement, le 19 novembre, le jeu créé par Rockstar Games ne cesse de pulvériser tous les records avec 3,79 milliards de dollars réalisés dans les premières 24 heures de disponibilité du titre et 32,5 millions de précommandes enregistrées, selon le site NEXT . Du jamais vu pour le monde vidéoludique mais aussi pour l’univers du divertissement dans sa globalité, cette nouvelle édition de Grand Theft Auto représentant le plus gros lancement de l’histoire du divertissement, tous supports confondus.
Depuis son lancement, GTA VI ne cesse de faire parler. Le blockbuster de Rockstar a notamment suscité la colère des sphères masculinistes qui voient dans le jeu les symboles du wokisme ou d’un féminisme exacerbé. Le jeu est également accusé de prôner une certaine violence, malgré les précautions de ses créateurs, selon Jeuxvidéos.com . Ceci étant dit, en dépit de ces polémiques, GTA VI semble largement convaincre les fans, à l’instar de sa bande originale réunissant des artistes internationaux mais aussi français. Parmi eux, on retrouve les groupes Justice , Daft Punk et Phoenix, ainsi que le DJ, Étienne de Crecy.
Autre surprise venue de l’Hexagone : la chanson de Sylvie Vartan, Danse ta vie , sortie en 1983. Au milieu de la radio Kaleidoscope FM (la radio de Vice City), qui met en avant des titres méconnus et insolites, trône en effet le titre de l’icône du yé-yé. Une reprise francisée de Flashdance… What a Feeling devenue Danse ta vie. Depuis sa diffusion dans le jeu, la chanson cartonne. Volum parle ainsi « d’une association GTA x Sylvie Vartan tellement inattendue qu’elle cartonne » .
🎮 FUN FACT Il est possible d’entendre un MORCEAU avec des PAROLES EN FRANÇAIS dans GTA VI !! Le morceau « Danse ta vie » de Sylvie Vartan est diffusé sur la radio KALEIDOSCOPE FM 🎶🇫🇷 https://t.co/0x1oSSK3yQ
La chanson a enregistré une hausse de 2500% d’écoutes sur Spotify depuis le 20 novembre, lendemain de la sortie du jeu, selon le géant du streaming audio. Il précise, par ailleurs, que le titre a enregistré une large augmention en France mais aussi au Canada, aux États-Unis ainsi qu’en Allemagne.
De son côté, l’interprète de Danse ta vie a réagi à ce nouveau record par l’intermédiaire de l’ AFP et du Huffpost : « Ça a été une surprise totale, donc c’est absolument génial de savoir qu’une chanson que je chantais il y a quelques années a voyagé un peu partout et va encore renaître ».

articles.t: GTA 6 sur PC : les moddeurs implorent les IA de « travailler plus vite » après la fuite d’une build Xbox
articles.txt:
La course pour faire tourner Grand Theft Auto 6 sur PC prend une tournure inédite. Après la fermeture du projet communautaire Project Leonida par Rockstar, d’autres groupes de moddeurs ont repris le flambeau, s’appuyant sur une prétendue build Xbox quasi finale du jeu ayant fuité cette semaine. Leur méthode : demander à des IA génératives de décompiler et recompiler le code, avec des prompts aussi directs que « travaille plus vite » ou « ne fais aucune erreur ».
Le point de départ de cette nouvelle vague d’activité est la diffusion, par le leaker connu sous le pseudonyme CyberLeek , d’une version du jeu décrite comme « quasi finale » pour Xbox . Cette build servirait de base aux travaux de portage vers PC. Auparavant, les communautés de moddeurs utilisaient déjà des outils d’IA pour analyser le code de la version console, mais cette fuite a démultiplié les tentatives.
Sur les réseaux sociaux, l’utilisateur chasm , qui suit de près ces communautés, a partagé des captures d’écran des invites envoyées aux chatbots. On y voit des moddeurs, parfois en direct sur des plateformes de streaming, demander à l’IA de « continuer à chercher des choses et à travailler », ou encore de « trouver un moyen plus rapide d’itérer ». Ces échanges illustrent une dépendance croissante à l’égard des modèles de langage pour mener à bien une tâche aussi complexe que le portage d’un jeu AAA.
Rockstar n’est pas resté inactif. Après avoir obtenu la suppression du serveur Discord et du dépôt GitHub de Project Leonida – y compris ses 3 006 forks – l’éditeur semble désormais cibler les publications en ligne qui documentent l’avancement de ces projets. L’utilisateur chasm a ainsi indiqué que ses propres messages avaient été retirés « en réponse à un signalement du détenteur des droits d’auteur ».
Cette stratégie de répétition des DMCA n’est pas nouvelle, mais elle prend ici une ampleur particulière en raison de la notoriété du jeu et de la détermination des moddeurs. La fermeture de Project Leonida n’a pas découragé les autres groupes, qui semblent au contraire redoubler d’efforts pour être les premiers à proposer une version jouable sur PC.
Une vidéo partagée sur les réseaux sociaux montre le jeu tournant sur PC, dépassant le simple écran de démarrage que les moddeurs avaient atteint quelques heures après la fuite. Les images, qui s’affichent à moins de 5 images par seconde , témoignent d’un rendu visuel correct mais d’une optimisation encore très loin des standards. Ce résultat, bien que préliminaire, prouve que la décompilation et la recompilation progressent.
Si Rockstar ne parvient pas à stopper ces initiatives, de nouvelles mises à jour sur l’avancement du portage pourraient voir le jour dans les prochains jours. La communauté reste très active, et les diffusions en direct des sessions de codage assisté par IA attirent un public curieux.
Pour l’instant, Grand Theft Auto 6 n’a été officiellement annoncé que sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X/S , avec une sortie prévue à l’automne 2025. Rockstar n’a donné aucune indication sur une éventuelle version PC, ce qui alimente la frustration d’une partie des joueurs et explique l’empressement des moddeurs à créer leur propre portage.
Cette situation n’est pas sans rappeler les précédents de GTA V ou Red Dead Redemption 2 , dont les versions PC sont arrivées bien après les sorties console. Mais l’utilisation massive d’outils d’IA pour accélérer le processus est une nouveauté qui pourrait changer la donne, tant pour les moddeurs que pour les éditeurs.
En attendant une éventuelle annonce officielle, les joueurs PC devront se contenter de suivre de loin les avancées de ces projets non officiels, tout en gardant à l’esprit les risques juridiques encourus par leurs auteurs.

articles.t: Seven Improvements We
articles.chapeau: Grander Theft Auto
articles.txt:
There's no two ways about it: GTA VI is a blummin' brilliant game, well worthy of its universally acclaimed 99 Metacritic score. But just because we gave it a 10/10 here at Pure Xbox doesn't mean there isn't still some wiggle room for improvement.
Both Fraser and I have put many hours into this enormous RPG already, and have come away floored by its grandeur. However, we've also noticed a few things we'd like to see fixed or added to GTA VI to make it even better. Think of this article like adding marshmallows to a hot chocolate: we're looking to take something great and make it even sweeter.
We've whipped up a few of our own suggestions and mixed in some from across the world wide webbies to bring you our top improvements we'd like to see in GTA VI. Let's get into it:
You've all noticed the darkness that appears from time to time around the screen, right? That's a vignette and GTA VI is a big fan of them. It's most noticeable when you're booking it down the North 97 highway or, in the worst-case scenario, flying over the Keys as shown in the above screenshot.
GTA VI uses vignettes to cleverly draw your focus to the most important parts of the screen. I honestly think it's a great technique for making things feel more cinematic. Although, it is quite pants that there's no option to reduce its intensity or turn it off altogether. If Rockstar could give us the ability to toggle the vignette on and off, that would be great, because it also seems to be one of the most requested changes amongst GTA VI players.
Something I've grown increasingly aware of is the inability to wait or sleep to pass time across Leonida. I was particularly irked after an 18-hole crazy golf competition against Jason saw the sun set on us, and I didn't fancy driving all the way back to my lodging in Vice City. I wanted to pass time in my car or a nearby eatery, but my only option appeared to be the 4-5 minute drive home - made worse knowing that once morning hit, I'd just want to do the drive back and play golf in the daylight.
It's probably the fault of Red Dead Redemption 2 and its extremely handy wilderness camps. They were great in a pinch to let you pass time quickly. What would be great is if GTA VI gave players the option to rough it in their car for the night or find a nearby hotel room or something.
I was on a mission to pick up some prescription drugs when my car was escorted slowly into an enemy compound and the camera suddenly switched from third-person to first-person. Seeing Lucia's impeccable nails gripped around the steering wheel made me realise there's no legitimate way to drive from a behind-the-wheel perspective.
Sure, there's that glitch that lets you play GTA VI in first-person, but it would be better if Rockstar implemented an additional first-person POV for driving.
It seems like a bit of a no-brainer, but we'd love to see AMD FSR 4.1 implementation on Xbox Series X . GTA VI is already up-and-running with FSR 4.1 on Xbox Series S which brings internal resolutions up from 720p to 1080p output. It's good going on XSS, but we'd like to see what it can do with XSX.
If a game launches with a good Photo Mode, then you may as well tack an extra 10 hours onto my playthrough. But GTA VI? Maybe add another 20-30 hours. It's gorgeous!
The Photo Mode in this game is already solid. You can set up light sources, adjust focus and aperture, and as a graduate photographer, I think it's all rather intuitive. There's even a selfie mode where players can pose Jason and Lucia together, adjust their facial expressions and change their poses.
What I'd like to see is that same flexibility expand beyond selfie mode. I'd like to be able to adjust the lovers to better match the photos I'm trying to create. It was during a tense getaway, four-stars and neck-deep in trouble, that I thought I'd take an action shot, only to find Jason had blinked and Lucia looked bored as hell. It would be great to have the option to adjust expressions, head directions, poses and all that sort of stuff.
Please fix the sliders when handling amounts of money, Rockstar. Please. It's not the biggest fix, nor the most elaborate, so I'll keep it brief.
Whenever I open my phone to buck myself some cash, I often struggle to select the right amount quickly. articles.t: GTA 6 May Actually Play Better on Xbox After All
articles.chapeau: PlayStation 5 might not be the best place to play Rockstar’s latest
articles.txt:
In the lead-up to the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , Sony and Rockstar Games have stated that the highly anticipated game "plays best on PS5." For some gamers looking to purchase a console solely to play GTA 6​​​​​​​ , this statement may be the deciding factor in getting an Xbox or a PlayStation. Yet, about a week after the game was released, it now appears that Xbox gamers may not actually be at as great a disadvantage​​​​​​​ as Sony would like you to think.
The tech aficionados at Digital Foundry have published a comprehensive comparison of how GTA 6 runs on all available platforms. While the details of the report are fascinating, let's cut right to the shocking results. It turns out GTA 6 actually plays better on Xbox... in the right circumstances. When comparing the base PlayStation 5 to the Xbox Series X (which are relatively equivalent), Digital Foundry discovered that while the visuals are basically the same on the two consoles, there is a clearer distinction when comparing performance​​​​​​​ . Digital Foundry stated that "PS5 suffers substantially more frequent frame-rate drops than Series X, which is compounded by the fact that the Xbox machine also benefits from 120 Hz VRR support to smooth out minor dips," concluding that "Ultimately​​​​​​​ , Series X is meaningfully better off."
It is important to note that Digital Foundry's study is strictly focused on technical performance, which ignores a big reason GTA 6 has been stated to play best on PS5: the controller . Sony's DualSense offers unique features like haptic feedback and adaptive triggers tuned to every little detail in the game, such as the weight of a gas pedal in a car or the buzz of a phone. It makes the experience more immersive.​​​​​​​ To the average gamer, the slight difference between Xbox Series X and PS5 may not be as noticeable as the difference the DualSense makes.​​​​​​​ But tech heads will be glad to know this.​​​​​​​
Image: Sony Interactive Entertainment/Rockstar Even with the surprise that Xbox Series X plays somewhat better than the base PS5, Digital Foundry still asserts that PS5 Pro ​​​​​​​ delivers the definitive GTA 6 experience ​​​​​​​ thanks to its larger GPU, Sony's PSSR upscaling, and more. All of this allows for the most stable version of GTA 6 . Given the price​​​​​​​ of every console on the market right now, individual gamers will have to decide whether the technical benefits justify the ever-growing cost of hardware​​​​​​​ .
Xbox gets another win with the budget Xbox Series S . ​​​​​​​ Despite being significantly less powerful than every other Xbox and PlayStation console on which GTA 6 is available ​​​​​​​ , the Series S still manages to put up a good fight. This is accomplished by lowering visual quality​​​​​​​ and taking advantage of upscaling from 720p to 1080p. While less stable than the Series X, Digital Foundry noted that the image quality is still decent.

Image: Rockstar Games Sony says more than 39 million unique players have now played Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5, and that those players logged 683 million hours of gameplay. The numbers come from the official PlayStation Blog, which also states that the game reached the highest concurrent-player count ever recorded for a PlayStation title. For a console generation that has produced several record-setting releases, it is the clearest GTA 6 PlayStation record claim yet, and it comes with a hard, checkable set of figures.
The scale invites comparison, and our earlier look at how the launch day ranks against other all-time games covers the revenue side of the story. This piece stays on the player side. It separates what Sony confirmed from what the internet has added, runs the arithmetic on the official figures, and looks at what the numbers mean for Sony, rival publishers and anyone still waiting on a PC version.
One caution up front. The headline phrase “shatters records” is shorthand, not Sony’s wording. The official claim is narrower and still striking: the biggest launch in PlayStation history, plus an all-time concurrency record. Everything below sticks to that confirmed language and flags every gap.

The source for all of this is Sony Interactive Entertainment, speaking through the PlayStation Blog. The post carries a title that sums up the claim: “Thank you for making Grand Theft Auto VI the biggest launch in PlayStation history”. Eurogamer, Game Informer and GamesIndustry.biz all reported the same figures within a day, and none of them added independent player counts of their own.
Here is the confirmed list. More than 39 million unique players played on PlayStation 5. Those players cumulatively logged 683 million hours. The average works out, per Sony’s own statement, to 17.4 hours per player. The launch period Sony cites runs from November 19 to 22, 2026. And the game set the highest concurrent-player count ever recorded for a PlayStation game.
Sony’s blog put the playtime milestone in one sentence: “Across PS5, players cumulatively logged an incredible 683 million hours of gameplay in GTAVI.” That is the only direct quotation we are using from the announcement, and the PlayStation Blog is the named source.
Every one of these figures is a PS5 figure. They do not cover Xbox, and they say nothing about a PC release, because no PC version has a confirmed date. Readers who see “39 million players” in a headline should read it as “39 million players on one platform.”
“Unique players” is the phrase that matters. Sony counts distinct accounts that played the game, not copies sold. That distinction rules out a direct translation into unit sales. A household that shares one disc across several PlayStation accounts could contribute more than one unique player to Sony’s tally while contributing a single sale to the publisher’s. The reverse also holds, since a buyer who has not yet booted the game adds a sale but no player.
The official wording also says “more than” 39 million, so the true count sits somewhere above that line. Sony did not publish the exact figure. Any article that rounds this to 40 million is adding precision the announcement does not support.
There is a second limit. Sony’s figure tells us about the game’s reach on its own hardware, and it arrives with no breakdown by region, by age of account, or by whether players owned a PS5 before launch week. The company also did not say how many of the 39 million bought a console specifically for this release. Reports of a console activation surge exist in the trade press, but the fact sheet behind this article does not confirm a number, so we are not repeating one.
What the figure does establish is breadth. A player base that size, reached inside roughly four days, puts the game in front of an audience larger than most publishers see in a full year across an entire catalog. That framing is our own reading of the scale, and Sony has not made the comparison itself.
The 683 million hour total is the headline stat for good reason. It converts a player count into time spent, and time is the metric that platform holders, advertisers and rival studios watch most closely. articles.t: GTA 6 hacker sentenced to seven years, walks free the same day after Rockstar Games leak
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 hacker Arion Kurtaj was sentenced to seven years for the Rockstar Games hack and released on license the same day, with Telegram and Discord banned.
articles.txt:
Arion Kurtaj, the Lapsus$ hacker behind the 2022 GTA 6 leak, received a seven-year sentence but was released on license the same day because time in secure hospital and custody counted toward the sentence. He pleaded guilty to six charges.
As an Amazon Associate, we earn from qualifying purchases. TweakTown may also earn commissions from other affiliate partners at no extra cost to you.
Arion Kurtaj, the Lapsus$ hacker behind the 2022 Grand Theft Auto 6 leak, has been sentenced to seven years in prison at Woolwich Crown Court in London, and he walked out of court a free man on the same day, just four days after GTA 6 launched on consoles.
Kurtaj was released on license , the UK's version of parole, as the time he had already spent in a secure hospital and in prison awaiting trial counted toward the sentence. The judge called Kurtaj "a very talented young man" before warning him, "Don't let this happen again," and Kurtaj is now under a five-year Serious Crime Prevention Order that restricts his online activity, including bans on using messaging/communications platforms Telegram and Discord.
Kurtaj pleaded guilty to all six charges against him on November 16, 2026. According to the Crown Prosecution Service, those charges cover hacks on BT/EE, Revolut, Uber, and Rockstar Games, where Kurtaj took 90 GTA 6 gameplay videos, released them under the alias "TeaPotUberHacker," and then threatened to release the game's source code. The CPS says the Uber attack alone caused costs exceeding $2.8 million, while Rockstar previously told the court the GTA 6 hack cost it $5 million.
3 Grand Theft Auto 6 artwork frames two characters through a car window; the game was the subject of the 2022 Rockstar Games leak. Notably, Kurtaj was handed an indefinite hospital order in 2023 after being deemed unfit to stand trial, with a psychiatric assessment finding he " continued to express the intent to return to cyber-crime as soon as possible. " Kurtaj was later found fit to stand trial and moved to prison, and one of his six charges was for possessing a mobile phone in prison in March 2026, the same month Kurtaj hinted from custody that the GTA 6 source code was still out there .

articles.t: GTA 6 Game Engine Tech Reaches 5 Fields Beyond Gaming
articles.chapeau: Carlo Harvey says game engines like Unity and Unreal now serve scientists and filmmakers. What the GTA 6 game engine story confirms, and what it does not.
articles.txt:
Photo: Garrett Morrow / Pexels Game technology already works far outside entertainment, and Grand Theft Auto 6 has put that point back in front of a mass audience. In a story on The Conversation , Carlo Harvey, Professor of Digital Arts at Manchester Metropolitan University, describes game engines as tools now used by engineers, educators, filmmakers, designers and researchers.
The timing helps. Rockstar ‘s game sits at the center of gaming news today, November 25, 2026, and readers keep asking what the machinery behind it can do beyond the console. We covered one side of that question when we asked whether AI world models could ever build a game like GTA 6 . This piece covers the other side: the real jobs that game engines already do.
Harvey’s story is short on specifics, and so is the public record around it. That shapes how we write this analysis. Every hard claim below traces to a named outlet. Where the sources stop, we say so and label our own reading as analysis. The GTA 6 game engine is the hook, but the bigger story is how a tool built to render a fictional state ends up on a film set, in a lab and in a classroom.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Start with the solid ground. Harvey, a Professor of Digital Arts at Manchester Metropolitan University, wrote the piece, and the university republished it on its own news pages. The story states that Grand Theft Auto 6 uses a proprietary engine developed by Rockstar Games. It also discusses two other engines by name, Unity and Unreal Engine .
The most concrete example involves film. Unreal Engine generated digital environments for Disney’s The Mandalorian , and those environments appeared on large LED screens around the actors and physical sets. Filmmakers could view and work with the scenery while they filmed. That detail matters because it shows a game engine acting as a production tool rather than a post-production add-on.
The table below separates what the available results establish from what they leave open. We built it to keep the rest of the article honest.
Rockstar did not hand Grand Theft Auto 6 to Unity or Unreal Engine. According to the Conversation story, the game runs on a proprietary engine the studio developed itself. That choice sets it apart from the other two engines Harvey discusses, which serve many studios and many industries at once.
A proprietary engine gives a studio control. The team can shape the renderer, the physics, the animation system and the tools around one game’s needs. The tradeoff is cost and focus, since the studio carries the whole engineering burden and cannot lean on a vendor’s roadmap. We cannot quantify either side for GTA 6. The story results do not establish development costs, team sizes or hardware specifications, so we will not guess.
What the GTA 6 game engine does show is the ceiling of what real-time simulation can reach. A studio that builds weather, light, crowds and traffic into one living world has solved problems that scientists, engineers and filmmakers also care about. The Star, in a piece on how the game pushes the boundaries of video game physics , reflects the same line of thinking. We read it as a signal of interest rather than as a source of figures.
The practical point for readers is simple. Rockstar’s engine stays inside Rockstar. The jobs described in Harvey’s story run mostly on engines that other people can pick up and use. That split between a closed showpiece and open workhorses frames the rest of this analysis.
The Mandalorian example is the clearest proof that game technology has left the living room. Per The Conversation and MMU, Unreal Engine generated digital environments that appeared on large LED screens surrounding actors and physical sets. The old approach asked actors to perform against a green surface and trusted a later team to fill in the world.
The story says filmmakers could view and work with the environments during filming. That single detail carries a lot of weight. Directors and camera crews see the setting while they shoot, so they can adjust framing and mood on the spot. Actors react to a visible world instead of imagining one.
Our reading, flagged as analysis, is that this shifts decisions earlier in the schedule. Choices about scenery used to wait for post-production. A real-time engine pulls many of them onto the shooting day. That change helps creative team

articles.chapeau: GTA 6 is the gift that keeps on giving 🙏
articles.txt:
GTA 6 is full of hidden tricks, and these 19 controller inputs on PS5 and Xbox will vastly improve exploring Vice City.
Grand Theft Auto VI ’s prologue is a major improvement over that which you’ll find in Rockstar Games’ previous release, Red Dead Redemption 2 .
It cuts down on a lot of bloat, introducing players to the world and mechanics much quicker, something GTA VI co-lead Rob Nelson told us was very important to the team .
What that trimmed-down prologue means though, is that GTA VI is pretty light on instruction; it trusts you, for the most part, to figure a lot out for yourself outside of highlighting the main controls.
It’s with that in mind that we’d like to share 19 hidden controller inputs that you may have overlooked but should make your rampage of chaos across Leonida a smidge easier. All inputs work across both PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
Throughout your time in GTA VI, you’ll get into plenty of fist fights and shootouts, but the game also features lots of vehicular combat. If you’re under attack while driving, you can hold Circle (PS5) or B (Xbox) to duck and avoid gunfire. Additionally, pressing Square (PS5) or X (Xbox) will allow you to open your car door into people, mowing down NPCs who may be trying to do you harm.
If you want to grab an adversary, do it by holding R2 (PS5) or RT (Xbox) . If you then want to choke them too, hold Square (PS5) or X (Xbox) and press the D-pad.
It’s possible to switch which shoulder you’re aiming from within GTA VI too if you’d rather look over Jason/Lucia’s left shoulder or vice versa. Simply press left on the D-pad (PS5/Xbox) while aiming, and you should switch with ease.

It’s easy to get distracted while driving around Leonida; the sight of a nearby NPC or building may prompt you to investigate, and while sometimes your instinct may be correct, leading you to a multi-hour side quest, that won’t always be the case. If you just want to quickly hop out of your car but keep the engine running, double-tap Triangle (PS5) or Y (Xbox) . That way, it’s much quicker to get going again.
There’s every chance that you might end up with an upside-down vehicle at some point, whether it’s a boat, car, or jet ski; the driving mechanics take some getting used to. If you do flip your vehicle, press L3 and hold Square (PS5) or X (Xbox) to flip it back to the right side up.
Got road rage? We’re going to assume the answer is yes. Double-tap R3 (PS5/Xbox) and Jason/Lucia will shout at nearby drivers.
On the other hand, plenty of players will abide by traffic rules. Use left and right on the D-pad (PS5/Xbox) to use your indicators/blinkers, and turn your headlights on and off by holding Circle (PS5) or B (Xbox) . Finally, look behind you by holding R3 (PS5/Xbox).
Driving and listening to the radio in GTA VI is one of the game’s greatest pleasures, following in the footsteps of prior GTA instalments. If you do want to quickly turn the radio off, though, you can double-tap left on the D-pad (PS5/Xbox), with the trick also working to turn the radio on. Helpful if you’re out in the open-world and hear something odd that suddenly demands your attention.
Not every traversal trick applies to your vehicles. If you’re sprinting to get away from Vice City’s cops, it may be easier to slide over a car hood rather than dodge every vehicle in your way. To pull this trick off, tap X (PS5) or A (Xbox) when you reach the hood. You must be at full sprint.

The ability to hold two consumables has caused a surprising amount of joy. Whether it’s two beers, two apples, or whatever else, GTA VI players are getting a surprising boost of dopamine from this humble mechanic. If you are just holding one item, though, press the D-pad (PS5/Xbox) to the left to switch the item to Jason/Lucia’s other hand.

articles.chapeau: Learn how to unlock Kodak Black’s secret radio station in GTA 6, including where to find all four WAiNK posters for The Sniper of La Perle.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google In Grand Theft Auto VI , players can unlock a secret radio station hosted by Florida rapper Kodak Black. However, you’ll need to scan four posters hidden across La Perle Vice City before you can listen to it. Here is how to unlock Kodak Black’s radio in GTA 6 and where to find all four posters.
To unlock Kodak Black’s radio station in GTA 6 , you need to scan all four posters for The Sniper of La Perle using the WAiNK app on your in-game phone. Three posters are in La Perle, while the fourth is inside the Jack of Hearts club in Crosstown.
Because of this, you’ll need to progress the story until you visit the Jack of Hearts in GTA 6 Chapter 3 to reach the poster upstairs. When you get close to a poster, look for the Waink It notification on your phone. Walk up to the poster, point your phone’s camera at it, and follow the scan prompt.
Head inside Aunt Zola’s Soul Food and immediately look to your left. The poster is pinned to the corkboard near the register and ATM.
Enter the TWA Ponya tattoo shop and turn right as soon as you walk through the door. The poster is sitting on the small table next to the entrance.
Go inside the Drip Drops clothing store and walk up to the register. The poster is lying flat on the counter beside the clerk that is running the shop.
Once the story takes you to Jack of Hearts in Chapter 3, take the stairs to the second floor and enter the recording studio. Walk through the studio lobby into the control room and look for the poster next to the desk fan.
After you scan all four posters, The Sniper of La Perle will appear in the On Demand section of your car radio. You can also listen through your character’s headphones. The station features 22 tracks, including Kodak Black’s “300 Blackout” and “Haitian Scarface.”
Kodak Black’s secret radio station, The Sniper of La Perle , features 22 songs from artists such as Wyclef Jean, Emeline Michel, and Alan Cavé . articles.t: Pourquoi ce métier de Vice City n'est pas représenté dans GTA 6 ?
articles.chapeau: Mais si, vous savez exactement de quoi on parle, ne faites pas semblant. C’est l’une des traditions les plus polémiques de la série, et beaucoup de joueurs se demandaient si elle survivrait à 2026. On a arpenté Vice City de nuit pour en avoir le cœur net.
articles.txt:
Mais si, vous savez exactement de quoi on parle, ne faites pas semblant. C’est l’une des traditions les plus polémiques de la série, et beaucoup de joueurs se demandaient si elle survivrait à 2026. On a arpenté Vice City de nuit pour en avoir le cœur net.
Chaque GTA traîne ses polémiques, et celle-ci revient à tous les épisodes depuis plus de vingt ans . Avec un GTA 6 scruté comme aucun jeu avant lui, on se demandait donc ce que Rockstar allait faire de ses fameuses dames de la nuit . Forcément on est allé vérifier, pour la science évidemment.
Pour comprendre pourquoi la question se pose, il faut rappeler d’où on vient. La série n’a jamais sorti un épisode sans prostituées depuis GTA III , en 2001, et GTA 5 ne fait pas exception . On les y croise la nuit dans les rues de Los Santos, avec des tarifs allant de 50 à 100 dollars, et ça n’a pas été sans conséquence. En 2014, les chaînes Target et Kmart ont retiré le jeu de leurs rayons en Australie, après une pétition lancée par d’anciennes prostituées qui avait dépassé les 40 000 signatures.
Pour ce qui est des filles de joie dans GTA 6 , on n’en a vu aucune dans les rues de Vice City ni ailleurs en Leonida , et on n’a trouvé aucun moyen de faire monter qui que ce soit dans notre voiture pour ce genre de service. Si ça se confirme, ce 6e opus serait donc le premier épisode en 3D à s’en passer.
Dans GTA 6, Rockstar n’a pas fermé tous les rideaux pour autant. On peut visiter plusieurs strip clubs à travers la carte, et il est toujours possible d’y payer un lap dance. Le jeu est même raccord avec son époque puisqu’on peut aussi se faire twerker dessus.
On reste prudent, puisque le jeu cache énormément de choses et qu’on n’exclut pas qu’un coin de la carte ou une quête annexe nous ait échappé. Mais après quelques tentatives habituelles de klaxonner à côté de PNJ féminin, ce qui est habituellement la démarche dans tous les GTA, celles-ci répondent « tu devrais avoir honte » , ce qui fait évidemment référence à notre sujet ici. La raison ici me semble plus qu’évidente, Rockstar ne voulait probablement pas ce genre d’histoire liée avec celle de Jason et Lucia . Ça évite aussi au studio de rejouer la même polémique qu’il y a douze ans.

articles.t: The Normal Person’s Guide To Understanding Grand Theft Auto 6
articles.chapeau: What even is this big game that everyone around you is suddenly talking and post about?
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is everywhere you look. Every news channel is talking about it. Celebrities and musicians are playing GTA 6 or posting about its release. It’s apparently the biggest game ever and has sold nearly 40 million copies already . But if you aren’t a big gamer or not a video game fan at all, you might have questions. I have answers.
Perhaps someone sent you this link because you kept asking them GTA 6 questions. Maybe you did a Google search, made it past the AI results and found this blog explaining what GTA 6 is to people who don’t buy or play games. Whatever the case, welcome. I’m going to walk you through what is almost certainly the biggest video game launch of the decade , why people are going so wild, and what the game actually is and isn’t.
It is an open-world game that mixes together a lot of video game genres, like driving, shooting, and exploration. As with most open-world games, you can run around freely or do story missions. It’s up to the player. You control two characters, Jason and Lucia, who are criminals on the run in fictional versions of Florida and Miami named Leonida and Vice City, respectively.
More or less, yeah. The developer, Rockstar Games, has been working on this game since at least 2015 or so. Turns out creating a photorealistic recreation of a chunk of Florida that players can explore and do whatever they want in takes time!
No. You can buy it on either PS5 or Xbox for $80. The $100 version comes with a bunch of extra outfits , hairstyles, and other items players can wear or buy in-game using cash they collect from crimes, but it’s definitely not required.
It took me about 90 hours to reach the end of the main story. I’ve since played over 150 hours, and I’m still finding new stuff, hearing new songs, and seeing new random events. Yeah, it’s big.
Well, a lot of people have been waiting for 13 years to play GTA 6 . The last new GTA game, GTA V , was released back in 2013. So anticipation for this game has been building for a long time. And, surprisingly, GTA 6 lived up to the hype.
There are a few reasons for the glowing critical reception. The game’s narrative is really good, featuring two extremely well-written characters that develop a meaningful relationship over the course of its five chapters. Another big reason for the high review scores is just how expansive and reactive the world is. Characters in the game will comment on your clothes, respond to your actions, and remember things you did hours and hours ago. It’s also a lot of fun to play, with challenging but rewarding driving, combat, and police encounters. And it looks incredible, with some of the best graphics ever seen in a console game. Some critics are calling it the best game of the year. And many players are calling it one of the best games ever.
GTA: Vice City on the PS2 was much, much smaller and less advanced (though in some ways it was pretty advanced for the time) and was set in the 1980s. While Vice City is a major location in GTA 6 , this is an unconnected and different version of the city from that seen in the original 2002 PS2 game.
So many things! Players can steal cars, drive boats, get into fist fights, shoot at the cops, go fishing, play mini-golf, hit the gun range, pet dogs, scuba dive, fly planes, explore the swamps, hunt deer, join in street races, visit the beach, get drunk, buy clothes, play fake video games inside the game, take a shower, eat food, work out, blow up cars, or just chill in a bar. You can also just play through the game’s main story, which is all about Jason and Lucia trying to make some money as criminals to build a life for themselves and their son.
Yes, Jason and Lucia have a child, a fact which was omitted from any pre-release marketing but is revealed in the first 20 minutes of the game. During the events of the game, he is living with his aunt while Lucia and Jason do whatever they can to make a good life for him and get him back.
She is an attractive but disturbing character players meet very early in the game who may or may not be a serial killer or creepy stalker. Despite this, many people online still want to have sex with her. Some players also think Jason should hook up with Mandy and ditch Lucia. These people are wrong.
No. While you can do that stuff, GTA 6 doesn’t force you to be a good boyfriend. You can be a real jerk to Lucia, and she can be a real asshole to Jason. Also, the chores players are talking about only make up a few minutes of the opening hours

articles.chapeau: D'après le décompte d'un joueur de GTA 6, on peut entrer dans plus de 1 500 bâtiments, soit près de 28 % du total. C'est plus du double des 700 intérieurs qu'annonçait une fuite en 2025. Rockstar Games a pris son temps pour développer GTA 6, qui place son intrigue à Leonida, un État fictif inspiré de la Floride. En
articles.txt:
Recevez tous les soirs un résumé de l’actu importante avec Le Récap’
Rockstar Games a pris son temps pour développer GTA 6 , qui place son intrigue à Leonida, un État fictif inspiré de la Floride . En résulte une carte immense, dont la taille n’est pas que de la poudre aux yeux. Il y a beaucoup à faire dans Leonida et, surtout, beaucoup d’endroits à visiter. On en prend pour preuve cette statistique ahurissante partagée sur Reddit par un joueur, Aileos , ce mardi 24 novembre.
D’après le décompte d’Aileos, qui n’est pas officiel, bien sûr, il y aurait 5 588 bâtiments dans GTA 6 . On pourrait entrer dans 1 563 d’entre eux, soit quasiment 28 %. Pour savoir si un bâtiment est accessible, il faut prêter attention à la carte du jeu : en bleu foncé, on peut entrer ; grisé, la porte reste close.
GTA 6. // Source : Rockstar Games (image recadrée) Plus de 1 500 bâtiments accessibles, mais pas tous en entier Combien d’heures faudrait-il pour visiter ces 1 563 bâtiments, quand bien même certains ne seraient que des garages dont on fait le tour en quelques minutes ? C’est par exemple le cas de la maison de Belville, aperçue dès 2021 sur une photo accrochée dans un bar du remaster de GTA San Andreas : impossible d’entrer dans la maison elle-même, mais on peut forcer la porte de son garage.
« Tu te souviens quand la fuite annonçait 700 et que tout le monde trouvait ça abusé. 1 500, c’est irréel », s’emballe UnknownApoc. poonslyr69 nuance : « J’imagine que c’est quelque chose comme 700 bâtiments entièrement explorables, et environ 800 bâtiments partiellement accessibles. Des trucs comme des garages ou des sous-sols. » Même dans cette hypothèse basse, les seuls intérieurs complets atteindraient les 700 de la fuite , un chiffre que beaucoup jugeaient déjà irréaliste.
Pour aider à s’y retrouver dans GTA 6 , on rappelle qu’IGN propose un guide officiel et gratuit , réalisé en partenariat avec Rockstar Games, qui comprend une carte interactive de Leonida. On attend maintenant celle ou celui qui osera se lancer dans la visite complète des 1 563 intérieurs, chronomètre en main, pour connaître sa durée. Il y aura bien quelqu’un pour se porter volontaire.

articles.t: What is the best ending in GTA 6 and how to get it? Full guide to unlocking the true finale
articles.chapeau: Spoiler warning: Major story details for Grand Theft Auto VI follow. Across 18 discovered ending variants and six core finale paths, GTA 6’s true best ending—widely known as "Happily Ever After" or "Two Years Later"—is the only outcome where both Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos survive, escape justice, and reunite with their son Tomás. Unlocking it requires hitting three gameplay thresholds before the "Meet with Abe" point-of-no-return mission—including banking $2 million and reaching Tier 4 relationship status—plus making two critical finale choices. Here is the exact step-by-step guide.
articles.txt:
Warning: This guide contains major spoilers for the campaign and endings of Grand Theft Auto VI.
Rockstar Games packed Grand Theft Auto VI with more than 100 hours of main story and side quests—and over 200 hours for 100% completion—culminating in 18 distinct ending variants spread across six core finale archetypes. Rather than relying on a single final menu prompt, GTA 6 calculates your finale from a combination of your relationship meter , criminal profile , bank balance, and final-mission decisions.
For players aiming for the happiest, canonical-feeling conclusion—known in the community as the "Happily Ever After" or "Fresh Start" ending—both protagonists must make it out alive.
When cornered by a police blockade on the bridge during the final sequence, unlocking the best ending triggers a short-term sacrifice that pays off after a time jump:
GTA 6 Lucia & Jason Happily Ever After Ending (True Best Ending) - Grand Theft Auto VI
To trigger the "Happily Ever After" finale, players must satisfy three pre-finale conditions before starting the "Meet with Abe" point-of-no-return mission, followed by two specific choices during the endgame:
You must reach the maximum 4/4 relationship level before meeting Abe. Build the meter by spending free-roam time together—grabbing drinks, robbing stores and gang hideouts as a duo, walking while holding hands, exploring by boat or helicopter, buying each other clothes or weapons, replying to check-in texts, triggering hug-and-kiss prompts, and spending romantic time together (which awards a "burning heart" boost).
Your combined savings must reach $2 million prior to starting "Meet with Abe" so the couple is financially set up afterward. Most players enter the late game with roughly $1 million and need to grind an additional $1 million. Clearing gang hideouts ($20,000 to $30,000 per run), completing vault heists, selling high-end vehicles, and hitting convenience stores are the fastest ways to hit the threshold.
While early guides claimed both protagonists had to remain at the lowest "Professional" notoriety tier, Forbes confirmed that "Hardened" also qualifies for the best ending. That means you can still shoot enemies and land headshots during campaign missions and gang hideouts—you only lock yourself out if you go out of your way to push your criminal profile into extreme notoriety tiers.
During the endgame confrontation, after you critically injure corrupt police captain Mendez, he offers a last-ditch deal to team up against his bosses. Do not accept—shoot Mendez promptly to stay on the true-ending path.
Once all four prior conditions are met, the "Swim for It" prompt unlocks at the bridge standoff. Choose it over rushing the officers to initiate Lucia’s escape and Jason’s eventual release.

Grand Theft Auto 6: how gaming technology is helping everyone from scientists to filmmakers
articles.chapeau: Game technology is becoming a serious tool for exploration, learning and problem-solving.
articles.txt:
The technology used for games like GTA 6 (pictured) is also helping engineers, educators, filmmakers, designers and researchers. Rockstar Games In Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6), released on November 19, players can explore the streets of Vice City and the surrounding fictional US state of Leonida. The game’s detailed environments reflect years of work to make digital experiences feel as close as possible to real life.
Aside from what hopefully amounts to great gameplay, this sort of realism is likely to be surprisingly useful in other fields. A US-German team of researchers has already used images from GTA 5 to help AI systems recognise roads, cars and buildings for technologies like self-driving cars. Because the game already contained data on the objects within it, the team were able to use this to label 25,000 images for training their AI system in just 49 hours. It would have taken several years to hand-label the same number of real photographs.
Many ways of benefiting from gaming technology relate to their engines, which are the software platforms used to build and run a game. GTA uses a proprietary engine developed by its maker Rockstar Games, but other prominent engines include Unity and Unreal Engine . These are helping everyone from engineers to designers to researchers to understand, test and interact with the real world in new ways.
One example comes from a project I worked on with colleagues exploring the diving tradition associated with Mostar’s old bridge in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Using Unity, we created a reconstruction that allowed users to explore the site in virtual reality, hear from a local diver and even experience a simulated dive from the bridge. The aim was to help people who weren’t familiar with Mostar to engage with this tradition and understand its significance.
That sense of being in a place also depends on what we hear. The way a voice echoes around a church can convey something about its size and atmosphere. With colleagues, I have explored how to recreate the acoustics of historic buildings alongside their appearance.
This includes a case study of Panagia Angeloktisti, a Byzantine church in Cyprus. Our team used filtering techniques employed in game audio to recreate how sound behaves within a virtual space like this church. The sound appeared to be affected by the environment in which it was generated, like in a real building.
Yet creating a convincing digital simulation is only part of the challenge. Understanding how people interact with these experiences is just as important as building them.
During the Mostar project, we carried out user testing to see if participants used the virtual environment in the way we had expected. The results led us to change an aspect of the interface that helped users to move around in the virtual setting. It was a small adjustment, but it showed why researchers cannot assume people will interpret digital experiences as intended. Testing with real users remains essential.
The same principle applies in engineering and robotics. In a project with the UK-based visualisation engineer Marius Matulis, we trained an AI system to operate a virtual robot arm inside Unity, enabling the AI system to move objects around. We then linked the robot arm’s movements to a physical, 3D-printed arm. The goal was to see whether skills learned by the AI in a digital environment could transfer to the physical world.
This approach is known as “sim-to-real” transfer. Researchers can repeat tasks and try different approaches in simulation before testing them on a real machine. Similar techniques have been used, for instance, to train drones to navigate unfamiliar environments, including forests and damaged buildings.
That said, the physical world rarely behaves exactly like a simulation. Sensors make errors, movements can be delayed and conditions change. Researchers call this the “reality gap”. Closing it means checking how a machine performs in the real world and improving the simulation where it falls short.
Game technology is also transforming the creative industries. One example is Disney’s The Mandalorian. The production used Unreal Engine to generate digital environments displayed on massive LED screens surrounding actors and physical sets. These included indoor and outdoor settings that might otherwise have entailed building expensive sets or extensive travel for location filming.

Report: GTA 6 Graphical Settings for Consoles Leak Out, Revealing Platform Differences
articles.chapeau: Thanks to datamining, the GTA 6 graphical settings for consoles have leaked, and this lists down the differences between each platform.
articles.txt:
Add as preferred source With Grand Theft Auto 6 now out in stores, dataminers and modders have begun peeking into the console-only title in a rush to get it running on PC. While it looks like Rockstar is doing everything they can to prevent that, some other details seem to be leaking from the build. Specifically, the types of settings the game runs on, and on each platform.
For those curious what exactly is different between each platform: the PS5, PS5 Pro, and Xbox Series X|S, when it comes ot graphics, we’ll now apparently know.
With PlayStation touting that GTA 6 plays best on PS5, here’s what that means (via GTA 6 dataminer Text2 ) for graphical settings.
For those wondering, both the base PS5 and Xbox Series X run with identical graphical presets, with the Xbox Series S running on lower settings, and the PS5 Pro being the only platform with additional ray -tracing features.
It seems the visuals are aiming for medium-to-high on platforms other than the Xbox Series S. This does beg the question: would a 60 FPS mode be possible if the settings were tuned down more? That’s hard to say, though; if we also cut the game’s rendering resolution, we speculate it might be possible to hit 45 FPS instead. Though that comes at the cost of graphics.
Interesting that the PS5 Pro doesn’t offer a non-RT mode at the very least to improve the 30 FPS performance.

articles.t: "Attention, vous achetez uniquement une photographie de la PS5" : indisponible depuis la sortie de GTA 6, la console devient la cible d'annonces particulièrement vicieuses sur Vinted
articles.chapeau: Depuis la sortie de GTA 6 le 19 novembre 2026, la PlayStation 5 est victime d'une pénurie, poussant certains acheteurs vers le marché de l'occasion. Des annonces trompeuses y proposent des photos de la console à prix...
articles.txt:
La PlayStation 5, devenue difficile à trouver depuis plusieurs jours, suscite des annonces trompeuses sur Vinted : certains vendeurs proposent en réalité… une simple photographie de la console. MAXPPP - Aurelie LADET Ajouter aux sources préférées sur Google Jeux vidéo , Faits divers , Internet et réseaux sociaux Publié le 25/11/2026 à 15:04 Article rédigé par Loïs Dzouz
Depuis la sortie de GTA 6 le 19 novembre 2026, la PlayStation 5 est victime d'une pénurie, poussant certains acheteurs vers le marché de l'occasion. Des annonces trompeuses y proposent des photos de la console à prix exorbitants. Ces pratiques, potentiellement illégales, sont surveillées par des plateformes comme Vinted.
Depuis la sortie de GTA 6, le 19 novembre 2026, la PlayStation 5 s’est retrouvée au cœur d’une ruée sans précédent. Avec plus de 39 millions de joueurs uniques recensés sur les différentes versions de la console, la demande a rapidement dépassé les capacités de stock des distributeurs.
Si bien que chez Micromania, la Fnac, Boulanger, ou même Leclerc et Carrefour, de nombreux rayons sont vides. Et lorsque des stocks sont disponibles, ils sont parfois proposés à des tarifs très excessifs. Face à cette pénurie, beaucoup d’acheteurs se sont tournés vers le marché de l’occasion. Mais ce repli vers les plateformes de revente a ouvert la porte à des pratiques douteuses, voire franchement abusives.
Plusieurs internautes ont récemment signalé des annonces particulièrement trompeuses publiées sur des sites d’achat-revente. Loin de proposer une véritable PlayStation 5, certains vendeurs mettent en vente… une simple photographie de la console, ou même uniquement son emballage. Le prix affiché ? Plusieurs centaines d'euros.
Bonjour @vinted @Vintedfrance Qu’est-ce que vous comptez faire sur ces arnaques de PS5? Cette personne montre délibérément qu’il est là pour escroquer, je signale et vous ne faites rien. Et de même pr ceux qui veulent procéder au paiement en dehors de l’app, vous attendez quoi pic.twitter.com/zWdy9fTPOd
"Attention, vous achetez uniquement une photographie de la PS5. Aucune console n'est incluse ni vendue avec cette annonce" , alerte le vendeur d'une de ces annonces. "Merci de prendre connaissance de la description avant tout achat afin d'éviter toute confusion" , se permet-il même d'ajouter. Une mise en garde qui ressemble moins à une précaution qu’à une tentative de protection juridique pour se prémunir contre une éventuelle réclamation d’un acheteur distrait, ayant cru acquérir une véritable console.
D'autres vendeurs ne se cachent même pas de leur pratique piégeuse. Dès le titre de l'annonce, il est précisé que l'objet de la vente n'est pas la console mais "des images de la PS5". Le vendeur réclame tout de même 180 euros. La pratique n'est pas nouvelle : en 2020, une première vague de fausses ventes de ce genre avait déjà fait parler d'elle. À l'époque, c'est surtout sur eBay que ces annonces fleurissaient.
Mais selon un avocat spécialisé en droit de la consommation interrogé par TF1 , cette précision ne suffirait pas à protéger le revendeur : "En cas d'abus dans la fixation du prix, un juge peut diminuer le prix, ou alors annuler la vente." De fait, demander plusieurs centaines d’euros pour une simple photographie peut être considéré comme un prix manifestement excessif. Cette situation est notamment encadrée par l’article 1165 du Code civil .
Une poursuite pour escroquerie pourrait même être envisagée. Pour cause, la formulation des annonces joue délibérément sur la confusion du lecteur. Dans la plupart des cas, le vendeur commence en effet son annonce par indiquer la mise "en vente d'une PS5 avec manette" avant de lister les différents éléments constituant le lot, et n'indique qu'à la fin qu'il s'agit en réalité d'une photo.
Contacté par le Parisien , Vinted indique que "toute présentation trompeuse" d'un article est "contraire" à ses conditions générales. "Dès que nous repérons une annonce trompeuse, nous la supprimons et prenons des mesures à l’encontre du compte qui l’a publiée" , assure la société.

articles.t: GTA 6 : ces 13 commandes cachées vont rendre votre expérience encore plus réaliste (oui, c’est possible)

articles.txt:
Voilà presque une semaine que GTA 6 est sorti, et le moins que l’on puisse dire, c’est qu’il s’agit d’un succès planétaire . Du jamais-vu dans l’histoire du jeu vidéo, à tel point que des pénuries de PlayStation 5 sont même répertoriées !
Et si vous avez déjà commencé à jouer, nul doute que vous adorez vous balader dans les rues ensoleillées de Leonida en incarnant Jason et Lucia, un couple déjà mythique dans la pop culture. Mais comme pour tous les jeux vidéo, il existe quelques astuces que l’on ne connaît pas forcément, d’autant qu’elles ne sont pas étayées dans le jeu.
Mais dans un post Instagram , Vice Central a énuméré 13 commandes méconnues sur PS5 et sur Xbox. Si certaines ajoutent simplement une dose de réalisme, d’autres peuvent s’avérer très pratiques. Les voici :
PS5 : gauche ou droite sur la croix directionnelle Xbox : pareil (gauche ou droite sur la croix directionnelle)

PS5 : deux appuis rapides à Gauche (croix directionnelle). Xbox : pareil

PS5 : maintenir L2 et cliquer sur R3. Xbox : maintenir LT et cliquer sur le stick droit (RS)

PS5 : Gauche sur la croix directionnelle avec une boisson en main. Xbox : pareil

articles.t: GTA 6 sur PC en mars 2027 : une fuite, aucune annonce
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 sur PC en mars 2027 avec GTA 6 Online ? Une fuite l’affirme sans preuve. Ce que Rockstar a dit, ce qui se contredit et ce qu’il faut savoir.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 sur PC en mars 2027, avec le lancement de son mode en ligne dans la foulée ? C’est ce qu’affirme une fuite partie d’un compte sur X, qui avance une date commune pour la version PC et pour un futur GTA 6 Online . Le problème, c’est que ni Rockstar ni Take-Two n’ont confirmé quoi que ce soit, et que la méthode décrite pour obtenir cette date n’est pas vérifiable. Nous avons donc recoupé l’information avec ce que les deux entreprises ont réellement dit.
Précisons le contexte. GTA 6 est sorti le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, et la page officielle du jeu ne mentionne toujours pas le PC. Les joueurs sur ordinateur attendent donc un signal, et c’est exactement ce qui rend ce genre de fuite aussi virale. Reste à savoir ce qu’elle vaut.
L’auteur du message explique avoir trouvé la date en analysant les documents financiers de Take-Two pour l’exercice 2027 avec un outil d’analyse, sans fournir la moindre preuve. Il affirme que Rockstar annoncerait le tout deux mois avant, et que le mode en ligne arriverait en mars 2027 sur PS5, Xbox Series X|S et PC. Le titre de la fuite parle d’une version PC du jeu principal, alors que le détail porte surtout sur le multijoueur.
Les chiffres cités pour donner du poids au message ne prouvent pas grand-chose. Les 8 milliards de dollars de prévision de chiffre d’affaires correspondent à la fourchette de 8,0 à 8,2 milliards déjà publiée par Take-Two, et les 9,69 millions de précommandes rappellent les estimations de tiers déjà connues pour les précommandes . Autrement dit, des données publiques ne valident pas une date inédite. Nous n’avons trouvé aucune confirmation indépendante de ce calendrier.
Le contenu décrit pour le mode en ligne reste à prendre avec les plus grandes précautions. Il comprendrait un personnage unique et permanent, des braquages en coopération, des courses de rue, des missions de contact, un système de gestion d’entreprise et des serveurs de jeu de rôle officiels conçus avec l’équipe de FiveM, que Rockstar a rachetée en 2023. Aucune progression ni aucun argent de GTA Online ne serait transféré. Rien de tout cela n’a été annoncé par Rockstar.
Du côté officiel, le silence domine. L’annonce de Rockstar du 10 novembre, consacrée au préchargement, présente les versions console, le jeu en streaming et le Remote Play, sans un mot sur le PC. Aucun nom, aucune date et aucun contenu n’ont non plus été annoncés pour un mode en ligne propre à GTA 6 au lendemain de la sortie.
Le patron de Take-Two, Strauss Zelnick, a expliqué en mai que Rockstar commence toujours par les consoles parce que le « cœur » du public s’y trouve, tout en reconnaissant que le PC représente désormais 45 à 50 % des ventes des grands titres du groupe. En septembre, il a laissé entendre que la plateforme devenait de plus en plus importante, sans date. Les rumeurs sur le calendrier, elles, se contredisent : un rapport appuyé sur quatre sources anonymes parlait déjà du premier trimestre 2027 pour le PC, d’autres signaux évoquaient un raccourcissement de la période d’exclusivité console , tandis que le mode en ligne était attendu un mois après le lancement, donc en décembre .
Une sortie avant le 31 mars 2027 aurait une logique comptable, puisque l’exercice fiscal de Take-Two se termine à cette date et que le groupe pourrait y inscrire les ventes PC. Le précédent historique plaide pourtant pour la prudence : GTA V avait attendu près de deux ans pour arriver sur PC, et Red Dead Redemption 2 plus d’un an. Un délai de quatre mois serait donc une rupture très nette avec les habitudes de Rockstar.
Mettre le PC et le mode en ligne dans le même panier relève, à ce stade, de l’hypothèse. Rien ne démontre que les deux sortiraient ensemble, et le fait que les rumeurs placent le mode en ligne en décembre, au début de 2027 ou en mars montre à quel point personne ne sait. Notez enfin que des projets amateurs tentent de lancer sous Windows la version Xbox du jeu apparue en ligne , sans qu’aucun build public vérifié ne prouve pour l’instant que le titre fonctionne. Le projet VIctory afficherait une première cinématique , ce qui reste très loin d’un jeu jouable.
Rockstar n’a communiqué aucune configuration, mais des estimations circulent déjà pour jouer en 60 FPS , à prendre comme un repère plutôt que comme un feu vert pour changer de carte. Sur console, le jeu tourne à 30 images par seconde et affiche un Metascore de 99 . Rien ne permet toutefois d’en déduire ce que serait une version PC.

articles.t: GTA 6 PC in March 2027? 1 Leak, 0 Confirmations
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 PC release date claimed for March 2027 by GameGPU, but Rockstar has confirmed only PS5 and Xbox. What is real, what is rumor, and what hardware to expect.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games A GameGPU post dated November 25 says GTA 6 will land on PC in March 2027, with a launch of GTA 6 Online alongside it. Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive have announced neither. As IBTimes UK reported after the console launch, there is no official PC version, price, storefront listing or system requirements for Grand Theft Auto VI today.
The game itself is real and out. Grand Theft Auto VI went on sale November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a $79.99 base price, as our launch-day price and platform breakdown laid out. What remains open is the part PC buyers care about: when a Windows build arrives, what it demands from a graphics card, and whether the multiplayer side ships on the same day.
This piece separates what is confirmed from what is leaked, explains how the March 2027 claim was built, sets it against Rockstar’s own PC history, and walks through the hardware questions a PC buyer should keep in mind. It treats the GameGPU claim as a rumor, because that is what the available evidence supports.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
GameGPU, a hardware and benchmarking outlet with an English edition, published the post under the headline stating GTA 6 will be released on PC in March 2027, along with the launch of GTA 6 Online. The body describes a leak that says GTA 6 Online will arrive in March 2027 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC at the same time.
The post does not cite a Rockstar employee, a retailer listing or a platform database entry. It says the information surfaced during an analysis of Take-Two’s financial reports for fiscal 2027, carried out with an AI analysis tool. That detail matters, because it moves the claim from insider leak to inference. Someone read the numbers and drew a conclusion about timing.
GameGPU says the analysis found an anomaly in Take-Two’s net bookings forecast of $8 billion. It attributes the anomaly to experts who link it to a major online revenue source launching before March 31, 2027, the end of Take-Two’s fiscal year. The same post lists risks, including server stability at launch, technical problems in the base game and the absence of a 60 frames per second mode on consoles, which it attributes to insiders.
None of that is independently confirmed. The takeaway for readers is simple. GameGPU is known for GPU benchmarks, but a hardware outlet reporting a financial inference is not the same as a publisher announcement.
The confirmed record is short. Rockstar’s own announcement, published through Take-Two’s investor site , names PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S as the launch platforms. IBTimes UK adds that Take-Two’s November 9 earnings release listed the same two platforms and the same date, with no PC release date anywhere in it.
The table below sorts every claim in play into confirmed and unconfirmed. It uses only the official product name, Grand Theft Auto VI, and treats GTA 6 as shorthand.
The last four rows are the whole story. Every one of them rests on reports, not on a Rockstar or Take-Two statement. Readers who see headlines treating March 2027 as settled are reading a claim as if it were a fact.
Financial-filing inference is a legitimate research method, and analysts use it constantly. Publishers guide investors toward bookings targets, and a large jump in a forecast often points to a big release inside the fiscal year. The method has limits, though. A bookings figure tells you that revenue is expected, not which product or platform produces it.
Three gaps stand out in the GameGPU reasoning. First, a jump in a net bookings forecast can come from several sources, including console sales of the base game, deluxe editions, catalog titles and other Take-Two labels. Second, the post jumps from an unnamed online revenue source to a specific month and to three named platforms. Third, nothing in the post separates a PC version of the single-player game from a multiplayer launch, even though Rockstar has said nothing public about the second.
The post also cites a pre-order count of 9.69 million, which does not line up with the figure we examined in our pre-sales analysis . When one number in a leak disagrees with other reporting, the rest of the post deserves extra scrutiny. We are not saying the whole thing is wrong. We are saying it cannot carry a publishing decision on its own.

articles.chapeau: Take-Two vient de faire supprimer plus de 3 000 dépôts GitHub liés au portage pirate de GTA 6 sur PC. Mais l'offensive juridique n'a pas freiné
articles.txt:
Pendant que les avocats de Take-Two faisaient disparaître d’un coup 3 007 dépôts sur GitHub, d’autres développeurs franchissaient un cap symbolique en faisant entrer GTA 6 dans son monde ouvert sur PC.
Certes, les images restent sombres, dépourvues de textures ou d’éclairage, et plafonnent à quelques images par seconde au mieux, mais il y a à peine deux jours, aucun de ces projets n’affichait encore le moindre menu.
Pour aller plus loin GTA 6 jouable sur PC ? Pas encore, malgré une nuit avec de vrais progrès
La notification DMCA de Take-Two (la procédure américaine qui permet à un ayant droit d’exiger le retrait immédiat d’un contenu) a été publiée par GitHub le 24 novembre. Elle cible Leonida, le projet le plus suivi jusqu’ici, ainsi que ses plus de 2 900 forks (les copies que chaque développeur peut créer pour travailler de son côté), un réseau dépassant le seuil des 100 dépôts que GitHub a donc désactivé en bloc.
Le dépôt principal avait pourtant déjà disparu dès la veille au soir, lorsque son créateur, NotRexed, avait publié sur X un laconique « J’arrête, désolé » . À cet instant, le registre public de GitHub ne mentionnait pourtant encore aucune plainte officielle visant le projet.

Take-Two confirmed a DMCA takedown of Leonida and 3,006 related GitHub repositories, arguing the GTA 6 PC port relied on leaked Xbox files and violated Rockstar's ban on reverse engineering. Projects persist: Leonida Continued does not boot, while VIctory reaches the world and intro slowly.
